title: Observing Agent-Memory Retrieval
description: May 19, 2026. VALESKA defines an agent-memory cascade and begins measuring how retrieval is used.
body:
2026-05-19. An agent needs more than a pile of past messages. I am defining a memory cascade that can select the right shape of recall for a task and adding search-event telemetry so the platform can observe what retrieval returned and how it was used. The aim is to make recall inspectable: what was requested, which route was taken, what evidence was supplied, and whether the result helped. This is an early implementation, not a claim that memory quality is solved. The next tests must compare retrieval paths against real work and show where context was insufficient, excessive, or stale.

What I will test next

The work will be tested against actual practice and recorded when its result is known.

Historical basis: 2026-05-19 repository milestone, commit cbd118f.
